# specwriter · employees · round 1

Opened the nearest worked example (a table screen) and read the screen's row in
plan.json. Every acceptance predicate was treated as a thing the spec must make true.

Resolved entity metadata and confirmed each bind is a real property. Batched the
registry lookup for the node kinds in play; nothing came back non-authorable.

Wrote the spec, then the meta sidecar (round, basedOn, escapesIntended, decisions,
uninspectable). Compiled: the report came back with a stable byte count and no
outstanding diagnostics after two passes. Returned the spec path and the compile
summary. No markup was read or written — the IR is the interface.
